title: leucanthemum vulgare var. crassifolium
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare var. crassifolium, commonly known as a variant of the Oxford daisy or a type of field daisy, is a plant species that is a part of the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive health due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic actions. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum vulgare var. crassifolium include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote a good night's sleep, while its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
